下列两种判定积分 ∫−∞+∞​1+x2x​dx 敛散性的做法哪一种是错误的？为什么？解法一

∫−∞+∞​1+x2x​dx​=lima→+∞​∫−a+a​1+x2x​dx=lima→+∞​21​ln(1+x2)​−aa​=lima→+∞​21​{ln(1+a2)−ln[1+(−a)2]}=0,​

故该积分收敛.

解法二

∫−∞+∞​1+x2x​dx​=∫−∞0​1+x2x​dx+∫0+∞​1+x2x​dx=lima→−∞​21​ln(1+x2)​a0​+limb→+∞​21​ln(1+x2)​0b​,​

由于两个极限都不存,所以该积分发散.

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x & = \lim _ {a \to + \infty} \int_ {- a} ^ {+ a} \frac {x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {a \to + \infty} \frac {1}{2} \ln (1 + x ^ {2}) \Bigg | _ {- a} ^ {a} \\ & = \lim _ {a \to + \infty} \frac {1}{2} \{\ln (1 + a ^ {2}) - \ln [ 1 + (- a) ^ {2} ] \} = 0, \end{array}
$$

故该积分收敛.

解法二

$$
\begin{array}{r l}\int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x&= \int_ {- \infty} ^ {0} \frac {x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x\\&= \lim _ {a \rightarrow - \infty} \frac {1}{2} \ln (1 + x ^ {2}) \Bigg | _ {a} ^ {0} + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {1}{2} \ln (1 + x ^ {2}) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {b},\end{array}
$$

由于两个极限都不存,所以该积分发散.

$$
\int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{x (1 + x)} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \left(\frac {1}{x} - \frac {1}{1 + x}\right) \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} \ln \left. \frac {x}{1 + x} \right| _ {1} ^ {b} = \ln 2,

\int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{x (1 + x)} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} \ln x \left| _ {1} ^ {b} - \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} \ln (1 + x) \right| _ {1} ^ {b},
$$

两个极限都不存在,因而发散.
